---
description: "Forms widgets, views, controls, screens, responders, and form content"
---

- Forms widget and view group overview:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Api-Widgets.h`
- Base visual object, geometry, visibility, focus, child controls, event handling:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Widget.h`
- Non-window visual container and view hierarchy:
  `include/Pt/Forms/View.h`
- Interactive widget base, input handling, layout, enabled state:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Control.h`
- Window or embedded form content and its root control:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Form.h`
- Primary display, scale factor, screen geometry:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Screen.h`
- Dispatch and handle widget events, focus, shortcuts, pointer input:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Responder.h`
- Enable or disable widgets and handle enabled-state changes:
  `include/Pt/Forms/EnableEvent.h`
